description: This file implements the NvramConfig class for managing modem NVRAM configurations, including loading from and saving to JSON files, and initializing default configurations. It also provides accessors for instance-specific configuration parameters.

classes.name: NvramConfig
classes.description: Class managing the NVRAM configuration for modem instances, including loading, saving, and default initialization. Provides accessors for instance-specific parameters.

classes.name: NvramConfig::InstanceSpecific
classes.description: Nested class providing access to configuration parameters for a specific modem instance.

methods.name: BuildConfigImpl
methods.description: Creates and initializes an NvramConfig object, loading from file if available, otherwise setting defaults.

methods.name: InitNvramConfigService
methods.description: Initializes the singleton NvramConfig instance in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the current configuration to the associated file.

methods.name: ConfigFileLocation
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the configuration file.

methods.name: LoadFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a specified file.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the current configuration data to a specified file.

methods.name: InitDefaultNvramConfig
methods.description: Initializes default configuration values for all instances.

methods.name: ForInstance
methods.description: Returns an object representing the configuration for a specific instance.

methods.name: sim_type
methods.description: Returns the simulation type associated with this configuration.
